parsed.public_message: Green's current controllable roster is one Ptolemy at 30% health, with no archers. I am disengaging and setting everyone neutral. Reports of a large Green army are outdated.

private_messages.Claude: Blue's two elephants and surgeon are now at (653,708), close to my hero. I am withdrawing south past your western flank. Intercept them while they are separated from any cavalry; killing their surgeon prevents recovery.
private_messages.Gemini: Orange currently has Hannibal, three elite spearmen and one cavalry at (707,655). Hannibal alone contributes 500 points. I am setting you neutral and withdrawing; your report of Green archers does not match my current roster.
private_messages.Grok: I am withdrawing south and staying away from your western position. Blue's surgeon accompanies two wounded elephants at (653,708). An opportunity to eliminate the surgeon could decide their fight with Orange.
